paragraphs.text:
With a successful Luck roll your host speaks English, go to 199. 
If you failed the Luck roll and can succeed with a Language 
(Arabic) roll, go to 199. If you failed those rolls, but you have an 
English/Arabic phrase book or dictionary, go to 175. Otherwise, 
you get a good night’s rest. In the morning go to any Cairo 
location on the Egypt Location Table.
(154, 169, 200)
